description: This file defines a cost calculator function for Gemini image editing models, which computes pricing based on model info and the number of images in an ImageResponse object.

classes.name: ImageResponse
classes.description: A type representing the response containing image data, imported from litellm.types.utils.

methods.name: float cost_calculator( model: str, image_response: Any, )
methods.description: Calculates the cost for image editing based on model info and number of images in the response.
